hb.alterHaushalt: The proposed allocations were not implemented. The existing budget continues; rejection reduces legitimacy and approval.
hb.mehrAusgaben: The decision raises financing needs. Higher spending or lower tax receipts support demand but increase the deficit and, over time, debt. Growth and prices also respond to other developments.
hb.wenigerAusgaben: The decision reduces financing needs. Spending cuts or higher taxes improve the balance but can weaken demand and services. The effects of individual allocations develop gradually.
hb.saldoGleich: The changes balance out in financing terms. Individual departments and social groups may still gain or lose.
hb.minister: {name}: {n} loyalty from the department allocations actually changed.
hb.reife: Effective at this report's date: level {wirksam}; allocation: {ziel}. Department maturation time: {monate} months, approached gradually.
hb.ersetzt: The allocation was changed again after this decision.
hb.bindung: Party agreements remain binding even if the budget fails. A larger allocation does not automatically fulfil a promised policy law: its fixed national target still applies.
hb.keineZusagen: No linked commitments or then-open promises to its supporters are recorded for this decision.
hb.status.unbekannt: Status at this assessment is no longer recorded
hb.quelle.haushalt: Agreed to support the budget majority.
hb.abkommen: The political cost of the majority
hb.vertrag: Signed on {datum}: {pk} political capital and {auf} attention actually spent; party willingness {n}.
hb.reifungErklaert: Comparison on {datum}: the same starting state of the monthly assessment, once with the approved allocations and once with their previous levels. It shows the additional maturation step and its calculated supply effect.
hb.vergleichGrenze: This comparison isolates the maturation step in this assessment. Earlier effects remain in the starting state; later amendments are excluded. It is neither the total effect since the decision nor the goods balance booked afterwards. War, trade, stocks and other decisions may change subsequent deliveries.
hb.wartet: No corresponding maturation comparison is available for this assessment yet. The next budget assessment shows what becomes additionally effective. If the vote is on the first day after that day’s budget assessment, this evidence starts the following month.
hb.keineReifung: The rejected draft creates no new maturation step. Existing allocations continue to take effect.
hb.beobachtungGrenze: These figures show overall conditions. They also include earlier decisions, the world economy, conflicts and other influences; they are not the effect of this budget decision alone.
hb.versorgung: Booked supply for {monat}: {n}% of civilian demand met; goods contribution to external trade {handel} bn USD.
hb.keineVersorgung: No booked supply balance is available yet.
hb.sitze: Government seats immediately after the vote: {vor}; at this assessment: {nach}.
hb.politikGrenze: The budget decision changes the loyalty of affected ministers. Party promises are assessed separately. Later support changes and departures may have additional causes; passing a budget does not cancel a broken promise.
hb.gefahr: Below 20 loyalty, the next review on {datum} risks losing {sitze} seats. Address open promises and hold talks in time.
hb.austritte: Departed at the review on {datum}: {parteien}. Government seats {vor} → {nach}.
hb.kachel: Outcome, binding commitments, effects and support in the monthly report.
hb.ersetztAlle: All changed allocations have since been replaced by later decisions. No new maturation contribution from them is attributed to this decision.
hb.deckungGleich: Coverage is unchanged in this comparison. Additional production may first change imports or stocks; demand coverage does not rise above 100%.
